title: The resume guard refuses a subagent's message to a finished reviewer
why: A subagent can message a reviewer whose worktree is gone, and the work sent is lost. The guard for the orchestrator case (resume-finished-reviewer-no-tree, #1917) does not see a subagent's sends.
note: Held on page item 412 (subagent-payload-probe): no record says which transcript a subagent's PreToolUse transcript_path names, and the lane's probe was refused by the auto-mode classifier. Lane resume-finished-reviewer-no-tree (session_013NEJL3qSsV2LJ6R1a1HMCB) runs the probe on pick a. Until 2026-11-21. Filed 06:03 CST Nov 8 (coordinator, 06:01 CST).
